idea-plugin.name: Top Status Bar
idea-plugin.description:
A compact, New UI-style status bar rendered as a native toolbar component for IntelliJ-based IDEs. Place it once on the Main Toolbar via the built-in Menus and Toolbars customization, and editor, project, VCS and runtime status appear right next to the search icon — no extra toolbars, no modified window layout.

Highlights:

  • Native look & feel: icon + text cells, rounded hover, light/dark adaptive, status-colored only when something needs attention, low-priority items auto-hide on narrow windows
  • Built exclusively on the public Action System API (CustomComponentAction) — no UI internals patched, no second toolbar row
  • Click menus and hover details reuse native platform implementations (line separators, file encoding, indent, memory usage details, power save mode, and more)
  • Items mirroring built-in widgets follow the native Status Bar Widgets menu (View | Appearance | Status Bar Widgets); plugin-specific items have their own settings page

Shown items include: line:column, language service, line separator, file encoding, power save mode, editor selection mode, indent, JSON schema, Git branch, read-only attribute, memory indicator, plus optional aggregator, network location and deploy server cells.

After installing, add it via Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Menus and Toolbars, select a Main Toolbar group, press + | Add Action… and pick Top Status Bar. Source code and releases: GitHub.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• First official release published from CI (tag v*), verified with the IntelliJ Plugin Verifier for 2023.3, 2024.1 and the latest recommended releases.
  • Memory indicator: clean text style (e.g. "700 MB / 1700 MB") with a warning color above 90% usage; hover shows native-style detailed memory usage.
  • Third-party widgets such as CodeBuddy are no longer handled and are hidden by default.
  • Click menus and hover tooltips for line separators, file encoding, indentation and power save mode reuse the native platform implementations.

action.description: Compact status bar for the Main Toolbar (New UI)
